Runbook: Players kicked from queue / dropped from match search
Symptom: players report being dropped out of match search after a few seconds.
Most common cause (2025): lobby-gateway websocket idle timeout too low, so the client disconnects and the queue entry gets reaped. Check ws.idle_timeout_s in lobby-gateway prod config and bump it to >= 60.
Also check: client poll_interval_ms, CDN websocket limits.
